title: Every VEVENT/VTODO Has a UID

citations.verbatim_quote: ; The following are REQUIRED, ; but MUST NOT occur more than once. ; dtstamp / uid /

The primary key for referencing a particular iCalendar component is the "UID" property value. To reference an instance of a recurring component, the primary key is composed of the "UID" and the "RECURRENCE-ID" properties.

statement: Every VEVENT and VTODO component in a calendar state has a non-empty string UID.
rationale: RFC 5545 makes UID a REQUIRED property of VEVENT (Section 3.6.1) and VTODO (Section 3.6.2), and RFC 5546 Section 2.1.5 makes UID the primary key for referencing a component. A component without UID cannot be addressed by any edit or delete operation.

positive_examples.name: event_with_uid
positive_examples.description: A plain event with a UID.

audit_notes: DTSTAMP is also REQUIRED by RFC 5545 but scenario vectors elide it; only UID presence is checked here.
